stem.text: Which statements about the transport of carbon dioxide in the blood are correct?

items: Carbonic anhydrase catalyses the reaction of carbon dioxide and water to form carbonic acid.
Carbonic acid dissociates into hydrogen ions and hydrogencarbonate ions.
Some carbon dioxide combines with haemoglobin to form carbaminohaemoglobin.
Haemoglobin readily combines with hydrogencarbonate ions to form haemoglobinic acid.
